notes:
# v1.3.43 — chapter labels and recommendations that keep up

- Fixed: Asura Scans chapter rows showed the number, subtitle and upload date
  glued together ("Chapter 276 Days Ago"). Each chapter now reads "Chapter N"
  (with its subtitle when the source provides one) and the upload date sits in
  its own date slot.
- Fixed: the Home recommendation rails ("Recommended for You", "Because you
  read ...", "More {genre}") never changed after you read a chapter. Reads now
  report their genres and content type to the recommendation profile, the
  cached rails are invalidated on every library change, and returning Home
  re-fetches them - so the rails visibly follow what you read.
